summary: ACRES Commercial Realty Corp. filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026, reporting that on November 2, 2026 it entered into the Seventh Amendment to its Master Repurchase and Securities Contract Agreement and Amendment No. 5 to Guaranty with Morgan Stanley Mortgage Capital Holdings LLC, acting as administrative agent. The amendment extends the facility to November 2027 and modifies certain financial covenants under the amended guaranty. The company acts as guarantor and ACRES Real Estate SPE 10, LLC as borrower. No price, stake or premium terms are stated. This is a routine financing amendment, not a special situation; monitor covenant headroom and facility renewal risk.
